Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Proven ability to define team goals and metrics, drive cross-departmental efficiency, and proactively address roadblocks for optimal results. Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible. Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time. Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers. The team is geographically distributed across North America. You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript. Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete. You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe. You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions. You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries. You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service. You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams. You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line This is a rare "0-to-1" seat: you'll help define the interaction model for a suite of product categories we are largely inventing, with room to shape not just how it looks but what it fundamentally is. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, About the Department Integrated Network Strategy is where Cloudflare's foundational infrastructure planning, network design, and capacity roadmaps are shaped. We own the systems and processes that enable our global network to scale across 337+ cities in 125+ countries while maintaining industry-leading performance and reliability. We design the architectural standards, capacity methodologies, and hardware evolution strategies that keep Cloudflare's network ahead of exponential growth. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we leverage our edge and network to solve infrastructure problems at massive scale and efficiency—something nearly impossible for any other organization. What you'll do We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our team and lead the design, evolution, and operational excellence of our global network infrastructure. You will own the foundational decisions about how our network grows: from capacity planning methodologies and hardware evolution strategies to architectural standards that inform infrastructure teams across the organization. You will work with a team of passionate, talented engineers and architects that are building the systems powering the internet's most critical infrastructure. You will play an active part in shaping the network architecture, strategies, and long-term roadmaps that will keep Cloudflare ahead of unprecedented scale. You will make sure our company hits our ambitious infrastructure and operational goals. You will change what's possible for internet infrastructure. If you've designed backbone and edge networks from the ground up, automated BGP policy and traffic engineering at hyperscale, driven network planning and sourcing to balance performance, redundancy, and cost, and led teams through major architectural shifts - this is the role for you. You bring a deep understanding of modern routing protocols (BGP, ISIS, RSVP-TE), software-defined forwarding, and the tradeoffs between automation, standardization, and operational flexibility. You excel at building extensible frameworks that allow teams to solve tomorrow's problems without rewiring today's foundation. You have a track record of taking on greenfield problems and turning them into repeatable systems and processes. Most importantly, you have the respect of infrastructure teams because you combine technical depth with strategic thinking and the ability to influence without authority. Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience Note: it is not required that you have all of these! Teams have varying needs, focuses, and deep expertise areas. 10+ years designing, operating, or planning large-scale network infrastructure at hyperscale (or equivalent) Proven track record building greenfield network architectures and evolving them as business needs change Deep, hands-on expertise with modern routing protocols (BGP, ISIS, RSVP-TE, QoS, traffic engineering) Strong experience with software-defined networking, overlay networks, and programmable forwarding Expert-level understanding of network economics: cost drivers, capacity planning, peering strategy, and trade-offs between performance, redundancy, and capital efficiency Track record automating complex network operations and building extensible frameworks that scale across large teams Experience designing and implementing DDoS mitigation strategies, firewall policies, and network security at scale Ability to design intent-based systems that reduce operational complexity while maintaining flexibility Strong systems-level understanding across the full stack: from hardware platforms and protocols through software-defined networking to application-level routing decisions Experience leading network design, planning, budgeting, and sourcing decisions for large deployments Ability to think 3–5 years ahead while shipping solutions today Proven ability to influence without direct authority; comfortable presenting technical recommendations to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders Strong writing and documentation skills; able to articulate complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading teams through major architectural transitions Comfortable working in a matrix environment with multiple stakeholders (product, operations, procurement, finance) and driving alignment Bonus Points Experience at a hyperscaler or large infrastructure platform (Meta, Google, Netflix, Amazon, Microsoft, etc.) Background designing and implementing network automation frameworks Experience with network telemetry, Netflow data analysis, and observability at scale Track record driving significant cost optimization through network design and peering strategy Experience with IPv6 deployment and evolution at scale Knowledge of SDN platforms, hardware abstractions, and vendor-agnostic network design Familiarity with Cloudflare's products, network, or competitive landscape What You'll Own Network Architecture & Design Design and evolve the architecture of Cloudflare's global network, including core infrastructure patterns, interconnection strategies, and edge deployment models Establish and maintain design standards that enable consistency, reliability, and defensibility across heterogeneous deployments Lead architectural reviews; anticipate technical debt and recommend major evolution initiatives, working across team Capacity Planning & Systems Design Own the design and continuous improvement of capacity management processes and systems used across infrastructure teams Develop methodologies for forecasting demand, modeling growth scenarios, and optimizing resource utilization Build tools, dashboards, and automated systems that make capacity planning visible, transparent, and actionable Hardware & Network Evolution Drive the evolution of network hardware and platform strategies, evaluating new platforms, vendors, and architectures Lead technical evaluations of emerging technologies (silicon, switching architectures, routing protocols, optical transport, etc.) Work with procurement, supply chain, and engineering teams to transition the network to next-generation platforms Next-Generation Planning & Research Conceive and plan multi-year technical roadmaps for network infrastructure, anticipating growth patterns and industry dynamics Conduct research into emerging infrastructure trends and translate insights into strategic recommendations Lead architectural exploration and validation projects that de-risk future directions before large-scale commitment Collaboration & Organizational Impact Partner with infrastructure teams to translate architectural visions into operational realities Work with finance and operations to understand cost implications and optimize infrastructure spend Mentor and elevate the technical decision-making capability of engineering teams across the organization What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Leverage ecosystem relationships to enrich Cloudflare’s analytics capabilities and build joint go-to-market motions. Available Locations: Austin, TX About the Role Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better Internet - one that is more secure, faster, and more reliable for every organization on the planet. The Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Zero Trust market represents one of the most transformative growth opportunities in enterprise technology, reshaping how businesses connect, protect, and empower their global workforce. To lead this next chapter, Cloudflare has created the Cloudflare One (CF1) Speedboat - a dedicated, cross-functional organization designed to operate with the focus, agility, and autonomy of a startup, backed by the global scale and infrastructure of Cloudflare. We are seeking a visionary, entrepreneurial executive to serve as the Vice President, CF1 GTM. In this role, you will own and scale a high-growth global business, define the GTM strategy, and build a multi-billion-dollar business in one of the most dynamic markets of the decade. This is an extraordinary opportunity to lead a “company within a company,” shaping the future of how enterprises secure and connect to the Internet. Key Responsibilities Own and Scale the Business: Act as the general manager of Cloudflare One business unit, with full accountability for global GTM strategy, execution, and P&L performance. Define the Market Strategy: Craft and execute a bold, differentiated strategy to establish Cloudflare as the world’s leading SASE and Zero Trust platform. Align product innovation, ecosystem partnerships, and field execution behind a unified vision. Build a World-Class Leadership Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a global organization across sales, solution engineering, success, operations, and GTM strategy - fostering a culture of speed, accountability, and innovation. Drive Operational Excellence: Establish and manage a high-velocity operating cadence, including forecasting, pipeline management, QBRs, and executive-level reporting grounded in data-driven insights. Champion the Partner-First Motion: Drive growth through deep collaboration with Cloudflare’s partner ecosystem - enabling global systems integrators, MSPs, and channel partners to scale Cloudflare One’s reach and impact. Be the Voice of the Field: Serve as the bridge between the market and the business. Translate customer and partner feedback into actionable insights for Product and Engineering to accelerate innovation and adoption. Lead the AI Security Motion : Own Cloudflare's GTM for AI-native enterprises - from Digital Native AI companies building on Cloudflare infrastructure to large enterprises securing AI workloads. Drive adoption of AI Gateway, Zero Trust for AI model access, and DLP for prompt-level data protection as the entry motion into this segment. Evangelize the Vision: Represent Cloudflare One as an executive spokesperson with customers, partners, industry analysts, and at major events. Position Cloudflare as the thought leader shaping the future of Zero Trust and network security.. Qualifications & Experience Enterprise Builder: 15+ years leading large-scale enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity businesses, ideally with prior GM or P&L ownership experience. Strategic Visionary: Deep understanding of cybersecurity, networking, and cloud ecosystems - including SASE, Zero Trust, SD-WAN, and network security. Partner-First Leader: Proven record of building and scaling partner-led GTM models and ecosystem-driven growth strategies. Competitive Depth: Track record of winning against entrenched security incumbents in enterprise accounts, with specific fluency in the SASE competitive landscape. AI Market Fluency : Working understanding of how enterprises are deploying AI infrastructure and the security, connectivity, and observability requirements that it creates. Operational Excellence: Demonstrated ability to design and execute rigorous operating frameworks that drive sustained, measurable growth. Inspirational Leadership: Known for building high-performance global teams and cultivating cultures of excellence, collaboration, and inclusion. Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; comfortable engaging with customers, analysts, boards, and global audiences. Represent the company externally with industry groups, government officials, enterprise customers, and members of the press to explain Cloudflare’s approach to Trust and Safety. Understanding of the Internet ecosystem and the roles and functions of the various types of online service providers. Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving complex and sensitive issues, often under considerable time pressure. You must have demonstrated the ability to thrive in crisis management. title: AI Research Engineer - Datadog AI Research (DAIR)
description: As a Research Engineer on our team, you will partner with Research Scientists to turn research ideas into working systems, building the data, tooling, and infrastructure that enable rapid iteration, trustworthy evaluation, and a smooth path from prototype to production. Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI , Bits Evolve , and our time series foundation model ), Datadog AI Research tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. We are focused on two research areas: World Models for Observability -- Training multimodal foundation models that learn the joint dynamics of distributed systems across metrics, traces, logs, topology, and events. These models power advanced forecasting, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, counterfactual simulation ("what if?"), and provide a learned planning backbone for our autonomous agents. Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. What You'll Do: Build and operate multimodal data pipelines, training and evaluation infrastructure, benchmarks, and internal tooling Implement models, run experiments at scale, and profile for reliability, performance, and cost Build simulation environments and replay infrastructure for agent training and evaluation Orchestrate distributed training and distributed RL with Ray, including scheduling, scaling, and failure recovery Establish rigorous automated benchmarks and regression tests for world model predictions, agent performance, and simulation fidelity Collaborate with Research Scientists, Product, and Engineering to integrate capabilities into Datadog's products and to harden prototypes into reliable services Contribute to research publications at top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML), and produce high-quality code, documentation, and open-source artifacts Who You Are: You have depth in distributed computing, RL Infra, and ML systems for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus You are proficient in Python, familiar with a systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go), and comfortable with modern cloud and data infrastructure You have practical experience implementing and operating ML training and inference systems (e.g., PyTorch or JAX), including containerization, orchestration, and GPU acceleration You have practical experience with large-scale model training and fine-tuning, including frameworks like Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, SkyRL, VeRL, or TorchTitan, and techniques such as SFT, RLVR, RLHF, and efficient inference (quantization, speculative decoding) You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences You have experience supporting or contributing to research publications Bonus Points (any of the following): You have strong software engineering skills with experience in domains such as observability, SRE, or security You have experience bridging research prototypes and real-world product applications, especially with large foundation models, world models, or RL-trained agents You have a passion for pushing the boundaries of AI with a focus on customer impact and scalable deployment You have hands-on experience with GPU programming and optimization, including CUDA You have experience writing production data pipelines and applications You have experience building simulation or sandbox environments for agent training Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. title: Commercial Account Executive
description: Commercial Account Executive (AE)은 중소규모 시장에서 전략적으로 신규 고객을 유치하고 거래를 성사시켜 Datadog의 전반적인 비즈니스 성장을 지원하게 됩니다. 영업 담당자는 잘 정의된 방법론을 따르고, 내부 이해관계자와 협력하며, 고객의 고유한 요구 사항을 파악하고, Datadog 제품의 가치를 명확하게 전달합니다. AE는 영업 분야에서 경력을 쌓고 Datadog 팀의 성공에 지속적으로 기여할 수 있는 기회를 갖게 됩니다. Datadog은 사무실 문화를 통해 구축되는 관계와 협업, 창의성을 중시합니다. 우리는 데이터독 직원들이 자신에게 가장 적합한 일과 삶의 조화를 이룰 수 있도록 하이브리드 업무 환경을 운영하고 있습니다. 담당 업무 아웃바운드 활동을 통한 신규 로고 확보에 집중 지속적인 제품 및 영업 교육을 통해 데이터독 전문가 기술 데모 및 협상을 포함한 전체 영업 주기를 관리 영업 개발 담당자와 협업하여 퍼널 상단의 활동을 촉진 최고 기술 책임자, 엔지니어링/IT 리더, 기술 최종 사용자를 전략적으로 전망 자격 요건 영업 사원으로서의 호기심, 추진력, 동기를 갖춘 분 창의적으로 어카운트를 매핑하고 세분화할 수 있는 분 피드백을 통해 학습하고 성장 마인드를 고취할 수 있는 분 고도로 기술적이고 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 편안한 운영이 가능한 분 검증된 성공 실적과 함께 할당량을 운반한 경험이 있는 분 Datadog은 모든 계층의 사람들을 소중히 여깁니다. 모든 사람이 입사 첫날에 위의 모든 자격 요건을 충족하지 못할 수도 있습니다. 괜찮습니다. 기술에 대한 열정이 있고 경험을 쌓고 싶다면 지원하실 것을 권장합니다. 혜택 및 성장 자기 성과에 따른 고소득 창출 기회 신규 채용 우리사주(RSU) 및 직원 주식 매입 계획(ESPP) 지속적인 전문성 개발, 제품 교육 및 커리어 경로 제공 MEDDIC 및 Command of the Message 의 영업 교육 사내 네트워킹을 위한 부서 내 멘토 및 버디 프로그램 포용적인 기업 문화, 커뮤니티 길드 가입 기회 풍성한 글로벌 혜택 위에 나열된 혜택 및 성장은 근무 국가 및 데이터독 고용의 성격에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다. description: Customer Success Manager (CAM) 는 온보딩, 상향 판매 및 교차 판매를 통해 기존 고객 기반 전반에 걸쳐 새로운 제품 애착을 적극적으로 유도하고 강력한 관계를 효과적으로 구축하게 됩니다. 내부적으로 고객을 옹호하고 긍정적인 고객 경험에 집중하게 됩니다. 상호작용은 무엇보다도 관계 관리에 뿌리를 두고 있으며, 성장 기회를 옹호하기도 합니다. 고객 성공 관리자는 잘 정의된 방법론을 따라 고객의 고유한 요구 사항을 파악하고 Datadog 제품의 가치를 명확하게 전달합니다. title: Developer Engagement Lead
description: Developer Engagement Lead Reports to: Head of Developer Growth · New York, NY NOTE: This is not a traditional social media or community management role. It’s a developer growth role that sits within the Product org. Developers are already talking about Datadog - on Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, forums, and places we probably haven’t found yet. We’re hiring a Developer Engagement Lead to make sure we’re part of those conversations. You’ll own how Datadog listens, responds, and participates across developer channels. That means running our existing developer social accounts, building our presence in new communities, creating the monitoring and response systems that help us find relevant conversations quickly, and connecting developers with the right people inside Datadog. This is a builder role. We’re not looking for someone to manage a content calendar or simply moderate a community. We want someone who can build the operating model for developer engagement at scale. What you'll own Build our developer listening and engagement system. Create the tooling and workflows to monitor conversations about Datadog, our products, our competitors, and the problems developers are trying to solve across Reddit, Hacker News, Discord, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Stack Overflow, YouTube, and other relevant platforms. Turn monitoring into action. Build a process for identifying conversations worth joining, determining when Datadog should respond, and routing questions or feedback to the right engineer, PM, DevRel, support, or product expert. Own our developer channels. Run @datadogdevs on X and Datadog Developers on LinkedIn, including publishing, engagement, replies, and experimentation. Expand where Datadog participates. Establish and grow our presence in places where developers already spend time. That may include launching Discord, creating a stronger Reddit strategy, building participation models for Hacker News or GitHub, or identifying entirely new channels. Make Datadog more responsive. Define response guidelines, escalation paths, ownership models, and expectations so developer conversations don’t disappear into screenshots and Slack threads. Participate directly. Know when to respond as Datadog, when to pull in an expert, when an engineer should answer under their own name, and when the best response is simply to listen. Create feedback loops into Product. Surface recurring questions, pain points, objections, competitive mentions, product feedback, and emerging developer conversations to Product, Engineering, Developer Growth, and other relevant teams. Get more technical voices into the conversation. Make it easy for Datadog engineers, PMs, researchers, and other experts to participate directly in developer conversations instead of relying exclusively on brand accounts. Turn shipped work into conversations. Find compelling ways to bring releases, changelogs, technical content, demos, events, and engineering work into the places developers are already talking. Build measurement that matters. Define how we measure developer engagement beyond follower counts and impressions. Track things like conversations joined, response coverage, sentiment and recurring themes, participation from technical teams, traffic, product discovery, trials, and signups. Run experiments. Test new platforms, formats, tooling, workflows, response models, and engagement programs with a clear hypothesis and readout. Keep what works and move quickly past what doesn’t. Who you are You understand how developers behave online. You’ve built an audience, community, engagement program, developer program, or similar function, and can point to outcomes you changed. You have strong judgment about when a company should join a conversation and when it shouldn’t. You are naturally curious. If developers suddenly start discussing something relevant to Datadog, your instinct is to understand why, find the thread, and figure out whether we should participate. You think in systems. If ten people are manually forwarding Reddit posts into Slack, you want to build something better. You’re comfortable with tooling, automation, monitoring platforms, APIs, AI, and lightweight workflows. You don’t necessarily need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working closely with engineers and technical products. You can create structure where none exists: monitoring rules, triage processes, response playbooks, escalation paths, reporting, and measurement. You know how to earn participation from internal experts rather than simply assigning them another marketing task. You move quickly, have strong judgment, and know what can ship immediately versus what needs another set of eyes. You have opinions about developer culture, platforms, formats, and internet behavior — and you update those opinions when the evidence changes. Your background You may come from Growth,Developer Marketing, Audience Development, Product, Media, Social, Technical Communications, or somewhere entirely different. What matters most is that you can show us how you’ve built participation around an audience, created systems that scale engagement, and turned what people were saying into action. Experience working with a technical or enthusiast audience is especially valuable. Bonus points for: Experience building social listening or community-monitoring systems Deep familiarity with Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, GitHub, Stack Overflow, X, or similar developer platforms Experience launching or operating a Discord or other owned developer space Experience creating triage, escalation, or response workflows across large organizations Familiarity with developer tools, infrastructure, observability, security, AI, or open source Experience using automation or AI to scale monitoring and engagement An existing developer audience or active participation in technical communities Strong instincts around short-form technical content and video #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. title: Engineering Manager I, Commercial Audit
description: As the Engineering Manager for Commercial Audit, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for scaling Datadog’s security and compliance posture through automation, tooling, and engineering excellence. Our GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) function is a critical partner to the broader Security and Engineering organizations, ensuring that Datadog not only meets rigorous global regulatory standards but does so in a way that is efficient, scalable, and integrated into our cloud-native infrastructure. You will manage a team of engineers and analysts who are transitioning to a GRC engineering direction to treat compliance as a software problem, leveraging AI, custom tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native services to turn complex regulatory requirements into actionable, automated controls. You will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Datadog’s Commercial Audit initiatives. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will grow a team of engineers and analysts responsible for directly maintaining our compliance programs and related audits (e.g., SOC2, PCI, HIPAA, ISO) while looking to improve efficiency and effectiveness through platforms and tooling. You will act as a bridge between technical engineering, legal, and compliance, enabling the organization to move fast while maintaining a secure and compliant environment. You will champion a culture of "compliance-as-code," identifying opportunities to automate evidence collection, streamline control testing, and reduce manual toil for both your team and our partner engineering teams. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You’ll Do: Lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Datadog’s commercial security compliance efforts, shifting from manual audit processes to automated, scalable platforms and methodologies. Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers and analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration. Partner within Information Security to operationalize a common control framework that integrates seamlessly into Datadog’s architecture and processes. Drive the development of internal tooling to automate evidence collection and dashboarding, reducing operational friction across the organization. Define and track program metrics: control coverage, audit efficiency, and automation adoption Collaborate with broader internal engineering teams to embed compliance-by-design into our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native service adoption. Who You Are: You build strong, trusted relationships across engineering, legal, product, and executive stakeholders. You remain calm under pressure, navigate disagreement with diplomacy, and consistently bring people to alignment without creating unnecessary friction. You are a steady, low-ego leader who earns trust through consistency, diplomacy, and sound judgment. You can navigate difficult conversations, resolve conflict constructively, and maintain strong working relationships across diverse teams. You have experience leading or managing teams in security engineering, GRC, or risk management with a focus on leveraging AI to build automation and tooling for transitioning to a GRC engineering approach. Strong technical background with the ability to review code (Python, Go), interpret architecture diagrams, and understand infrastructure (Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure). Deep understanding of the modern compliance landscape (e.g., HIPAA, SOC2, PCI, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and experience implementing them at scale in cloud-native environments. You are a clear communicator who can translate complex technical or regulatory requirements into "plain language" for engineers, leadership, and external auditors alike. You possess a systems-thinking mindset—you look for upstream root causes and downstream impacts rather than solving problems in isolation. Experience in a SaaS or cloud infrastructure company where security scale and complexity are first-order challenges. Experienced people leader with a focus on mentorship, team growth, and inclusion. You know how to build trust and alignment across diverse teams. You operate with both rigor and pragmatism. As a key member of Datadog's Event Marketing team – the driving force behind our high-impact, experiential marketing programs – you will play a critical role in executing best-in-class events that generate leads, pipeline, and scale our brand presence. With hundreds of events run globally each year, this role requires someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of delivering high-quality event experiences, consistently meeting deadlines, and collaborating cross-functionally. title: Field Enablement Manager
description: The Team The APJ Enablement Team empowers our Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Solutions teams with the right information, skills, and tools throughout their tenure at Datadog in order to maximize their ability to land, expand, and drive Datadog’s next phase of growth across the region. We act as strategic partners to the APJ Leadership Team, ensuring they have the support they need to achieve their goals. We regionalize and contextualize global programs, custom-build regional programs, and provide just-in-time support in order to deliver quantifiable impact on go-to-market performance in APJ. The Opportunity Datadog continues to grow at a rapid rate and with this exciting growth, our onboarding and ongoing training is also quickly increasing in scale and complexity. This position is responsible for providing onboarding and ongoing enablement training/programs to all of our regional go-to-market teams. We are looking for a structured communicator with a knack for simplifying the complex to deliver the training content, curriculum, and programs that enable our sales people to be successful in their jobs. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You'll Do: Deliver engaging live and virtual enablement sessions for regional Sales and Customer Success teams, including onboarding, ongoing training, and reinforcement programs. Conduct ongoing field listening (shadows, 1:1s, syncs with first-line leaders) to maintain a strong pulse on business needs, gaps, and strengths across APAC markets; share insights with the broader enablement team to shape programs and priorities. Lead reinforcement and coaching to drive post-program adoption, including designing activities (role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that connect training to measurable behavior change in real, complex customer scenarios. Partner with Curriculum, Program Management, and Operations to share field insights and pilot or co-build content, and work closely with first-line Sales leaders to build trusted relationships, diagnose challenges, and deliver ad hoc training in response to emerging needs. Use AI tools to accelerate delivery and reinforcement — including synthesizing field feedback and surfacing patterns — and model effective AI use for the teams you train. Who You Are: 3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role, with a proven delivery track record supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment. Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions to senior, sophisticated audiences, and familiarity with sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, Sandler, etc. (certification a plus). Strong business acumen and comfort using performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions; experience with Asana or similar project management tools is a plus. Foundational understanding of Datadog and/or the broader technology industry, including foundational knowledge of Datadog's core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value. Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented — you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners. title: Global Safety & Security Manager
description: The Global Safety & Security Team falls under the Operations Team that runs many day-to-day operational functions that help keep our employees safe, happy and productive. We work closely with leadership and employees to ensure that Datadog continues to scale rapidly, yet smoothly and remains a fantastic place to work. We’re seeking an experienced team member to join our growing global team and play a critical role in keeping Datadogs and its assets safe and secure. You will work directly with the Global Head of Global Safety & Security and cross-functional teams to support safety and security operations across the enterprise. Ideal candidates will be passionate about leadership, security operations, building programs, workplace health and safety, project management, customer service and collaboration. This position is based in our Sydney or Singapore office and will require domestic and international travel. The role will focus particularly on developing our safety compliance, security program development and maturity, incident, investigations and crisis management programs. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. Providing ad-hoc coverage for the EMEA and AMER region may be required at the discretion of the Global Head of Global Safety & Security. Oversee a variety of responsibilities, including investigations, health and safety compliance, security risk management, travel safety, event security, budgeting, crisis management, emergency response, property loss management and global safety and security system management. Enforce Datadog’s security policies and regulations regionally. Document and disseminate security protocols under the guidance of the Head of Global Safety & Security. Develop regional policies, technical security solutions, safety protocols, emergency preparedness training and liaise with local law enforcement in individual offices. Collaborate with various teams, including Office Operations, Real Estate, IT, Legal, Events and People. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders to ensure alignment on global safety and security initiatives and ensure all teams are trained on emergency plans and incident response protocols. Execute daily operations and strategic initiatives for workplace safety and security, contract security personnel management, and response to incidents in Datadog offices. Identify long-term needs in terms of organizational structure, policies/procedures and capital enhancements. Develop strategic plans to obtain executive approval, define objectives, secure resources and execute key milestones. Provide assessments and briefings to leadership, ensuring understanding of corrective actions, their impact and urgency. Facilitate tabletop exercises for regional offices focused on emergency preparedness, crisis management and resilience. Who You Are: Experienced in managing safety and security operations, ideally within a fast-paced technology environment, with a focus on developing security and safety programs and incident response plans. Skilled in managing all aspects of a physical security program, including but not limited to Executive Protection, Event Security and Travel Security. Experienced in building and growing regional and global safety and security programs to scale with organizational needs. Knowledgeable about global technical security monitoring systems, with experience reviewing architectural plans and planning physical security design. Familiarity with enterprise physical security risk management principles, including conducting security and safety risk assessments and implementing mitigation strategies. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively convey security information across all levels of the organization with specific focus to executives. description: We're on a mission to build the best platform in the world for engineers to understand and scale their systems, applications, and teams. We operate at high scale—trillions of data points per day—allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally for tens of thousands of companies. Our engineering culture values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way. The Team: As organizations rapidly invest in AI applications and build out AI labs, telemetry volumes are growing exponentially and costs are becoming unpredictable. From LLM interactions to agentic workflows, AI systems generate unpredictable streams of logs, driving up costs and making it harder to maintain efficient observability. These challenges are critical for organizations in regulated industries with strict data residency requirements, where data must remain within controlled environments. Datadog’s Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) team is reimagining what observability and security look like at petabyte scale in the AI era. The Opportunity: The Group Product Manager - Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) role is responsible for defining and bringing to market the next generation of telemetry analytics and insights capabilities in an AI-first environment. This role is highly technical and creative in nature as you will envision novel ways to enable customers to cost-effectively explore, analyze and report over petabytes of data through a welcoming and easy-to-use interface. You will partner with various teams to take advantage of BitsAI capabilities and surface critical insights on volume usage and retention for popular use cases. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You’ll Do: Lead and grow a team of product managers focused on Datadog’s BYOC Program Define the vision, strategy, and product roadmap for BYOC and make it immediately valuable to customers in an AI-first environment Gather insights from customers, partners, and internal data to become an expert on how customers want to store, analyze, and report on data for long term needs Work closely with Datadog’s BYOC, Log Management, BitsAI, and Platform teams to identify opportunities and build ingest, index and search capabilities for petabyte scale Make it easy for customers to onboard new workloads and products within Datadog onto the BYOC platform Recommend and launch new offerings with BYOC based on use cases for Security and Compliance Partner with Marketing and other GTM teams to generate awareness and drive adoption of Datadog’s BYOC offering Present to leading industry experts and analysts such as Gartner, Forrester and IDC to influence the market research teams and solicit feedback to guide roadmap Guide Product Solution Architects to build pre-validated architectures on getting started with BYOC for specific use cases and industry verticals Who You Are: A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent experience 7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Product Management, including 2+ years managing other product managers At least 3+ years of experience with databases, data warehouses, SQL concepts & language, BI products, and/or distributed systems Hands on experience using multiple services from one or more of the major cloud providers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) Demonstrated track record of working with executives and engineers alike Prior experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Splunk, or ClickHouse is a strong plus MBA is a strong plus Datadog values people from all walks of life. title: Manager I, Engineering - Cloud FinOps
description: Datadog's Cloud FinOps team answers a question the business runs on: what does each product and each customer actually cost us to serve? Finance uses this team's output to close Datadog's books, Product uses it to compare cost to serve against what a customer pays, and engineering leaders use it to catch cost movements before they compound. As the Engineering Manager for this team, you'll own delivery across the runtime pipeline, coverage onboarding, and cost-to-customer identity mapping. You'll own the contracts that Finance and platform teams depend on. The core engineering problem is reproducibility: every dollar of cloud cost is placed against the product and customer that caused it, with lineage on every result and closed periods that replay exactly. This role starts by closing a coverage gap and grows into owning the model every platform team at Datadog onboards through. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You'll Do: Lead and grow a team of engineers building the platform that allocates Datadog's cloud cost to products and customers, setting the operating rhythm across runtime and release, coverage onboarding, and identity and mapping. Own the publication contract with Finance: versioned metrics with effective dates, backfill, and reproducible history, so any closed period can be replayed on demand and trusted for close. Own the metric contracts with platform teams across Engineering, shifting cost facts to the teams that generate the cost so coverage growth stops scaling linearly with your headcount. Partner with Revenue Engineering on the cost-to-revenue identity join that turns cost data into margin per product and per customer. Drive continuous improvement in product and customer cost coverage and accuracy, and hold delivery commitments with teams that don't report to you. Reduce key-person risk on runtime and compiler architecture by spreading ownership across the team, and use AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, and similar) to raise the team's speed and leverage. Who You Are: An engineering leader with experience managing data platform or data engineering teams building batch and pipeline systems judged on correctness and reproducibility. You've shipped versioned publication with effective dates, backfill, and reproducible history. You've held a delivery commitment with a team outside your reporting line, and you can describe what happened the first time a contract was missed. You bring domain experience in metering, usage-based billing, cloud cost, revenue data, or financial data platforms. You operate without a product manager in the loop on the external half of the job: you set the contracts, negotiate the boundaries, and drive the roadmap yourself. If you've owned systems whose output is audited or closed by Finance (SOX scope, month-end close, revenue recognition), graph datasets or built retrieval-grounded systems where every answer cites its source and you know where a model shouldn't be trusted with a number at all, that is helpful experience. Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. title: Manager, Accounts Payable
description: About the Role We are seeking a Manager, Accounts Payable to lead Accounts Payable and Expense operations. This role will manage individual contributors and may oversee team leads while ensuring invoices, payments, reconciliations, tax reporting, and employee expenses are processed accurately and on time. The Manager, Accounts Payable will own team performance and execution while driving process improvements, automation, and reporting. You will work across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and other teams to resolve complex issues, strengthen controls, and improve the procure-to-pay experience. The ideal candidate is a reliable people leader who uses business context and data to make decisions, advises stakeholders, and delivers measurable operational improvements. What You’ll Do Lead, coach, and develop AP and Expense team members. Manage team performance, staffing, workload allocation, and day-to-day execution. Build a high-performing team with clear expectations, strong accountability, and consistent results. Oversee invoice processing, purchase order matching, coding, approvals, payments, vendor inquiries, and employee expense operations. Ensure AP and Expense activities are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies and controls. Own balance sheet reconciliations, AP close activities, accrual support, aging reviews, and related reporting. Lead annual 1099 reporting and support other AP-related tax and compliance requirements. Serve as the primary AP contact for internal and external audits, ensuring requested documentation is accurate and complete. Monitor unmatched invoices, open purchase orders, payment exceptions, duplicate payments, credits, and other outstanding items. Identify inefficiencies across AP and Expenses and lead process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability; Drive automation and AI initiatives related to invoice processing, matching, approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, and reporting. Develop reporting and insights using tools such as Zip, Ramp, Tableau, ERP systems, and other operational data sources. Establish and monitor performance metrics, including processing volume, aging, cycle times, exception rates, and on-time payments. Partner across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and business teams and lead cross-functional initiatives when needed. Evaluate complex issues using business context, advise team members and stakeholders, and recommend practical solutions. Escalate risks and issues that could affect costs, controls, service levels, or short-term business goals. What You’ll Bring 7+ years of experience in accounts payable, Expenses, accounting operations, or procure-to-pay, including people-management experience. Proven ability to lead teams, manage performance, and deliver reliable results. Experience owning and improving an operational area with measurable impact. Strong knowledge of invoice processing, purchase orders, payments, expense management, reconciliations, accruals, and the monthly close. Experience managing 1099 reporting and supporting internal and external audits. Experience using procurement or finance platforms such as Zip, NetSuite, and Ramp. Sound judgment when addressing diverse challenges, applying policies, and escalating financial or operational risks. Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and reliability in a high-volume environment. title: Manager, Business Recruiting - Enterprise Sales
description: As a Manager on our Business Recruiting team, you’ll lead a team of recruiters responsible for hiring across Americas Enterprise Sales. You’ll operate as a coach—developing your team, driving recruiting strategy and execution against ambitious growth goals, and directly supporting strategic and leadership-level searches when needed. You’ll serve as the primary recruiting partner to Enterprise Sales leadership, using talent market insights, recruiting data, and a deep understanding of the business to advise leaders, anticipate hiring needs, and build scalable strategies for attracting and hiring exceptional sales talent. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture—the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. Own recruiting strategy and execution for Enterprise Sales, partnering with leadership on headcount forecasting, hiring priorities, capacity planning, and progress against growth goals. Operate as a player/coach, directly leading strategic, complex, or leadership-level searches while helping your team navigate challenging hiring needs. Act as a trusted advisor to Sales leaders and hiring managers, providing guidance on talent profiles, market dynamics, hiring strategy, interview processes, and recruiting best practices. Coach your team to build strong and diverse talent pipelines and foster high-touch relationships with active and passive candidates. Use recruiting funnel metrics and market insights to identify challenges, recommend solutions, and drive changes that improve hiring outcomes and team effectiveness. Develop and evolve sourcing strategies, candidate messaging, job descriptions, events, and other talent initiatives to strengthen our ability to attract Enterprise Sales talent. Stay ahead of recruiting and talent market trends, translating insights into training and guidance for recruiters and hiring teams across sourcing, interviewing, profile identification, and process optimization. Who You Are Experienced with 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting, including experience recruiting Sales talent, preferably within a high-growth technology environment. An experienced people leader with 1+ years of direct management experience leading a team of 2+ recruiters and a track record of coaching and developing others. A strong strategic partner who can build credibility with senior leaders, influence hiring decisions, and translate business needs into effective recruiting strategies. title: Manager, Global Entity Management
description: About the role Datadog employs roughly 8,100 people across 35 countries through global subsidiaries, all under a Nevada parent. Some are operating companies. Others came to us through acquisitions. We open in new markets often enough that the structure is always moving, and we manage it in Diligent Entities. This role owns it. The work is entity formation and maintenance in many jurisdictions, corporate records and statutory filings, and daily coordination with the Finance, Tax and People teams. You will deal directly with government agencies, registries, registered agents and local counsel around the world. You will also be the person the rest of the company asks whenever a question touches our corporate structure. The role sits in Legal Operations, and you will report to our Senior Director, Legal Operations, who has supported entity management operations in the past. Our Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Securities owns the work product and sets the standards for entity management and for our securities filings. Legal Operations runs the function; Corporate & Securities owns the substance. The placement also gives you breadth. Legal Operations covers legal technology and systems, process design, outside counsel and spend operations, restricted party and sanctions screening, product legal support, and the department's AI work. We expect to cross-train you across those areas over time, and to cross-train colleagues into entity work. Entity management will remain the substantial majority of this job. On AI in particular, Legal Operations is where most of that work happens for the legal department. We look at how our current tools could be used better, we assess new ones, and we look for ways to extend AI into systems that were never built with it in mind. If you look at a manual process and wonder whether software should be doing it, there is room here for that. On the securities side of the role You will also handle Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4 and 5), Forms 144 and Rule 10b5-1 plan administration, supervised by our Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Securities, who trains the team on it. Prior public company reporting experience is welcome but not required. We have trained people into this work before and it went well. What we need is someone who wants to learn it and who will hold the deadlines once trained. What you will do Global entity management: the core of the role Entity lifecycle. Manage formations, foreign qualifications, branch registrations, conversions, mergers, dissolutions, liquidations and deregistrations for our US and international entities, working with outside service providers and local counsel in each jurisdiction. Good standing. Keep every entity in good standing wherever it operates. That covers annual reports and returns, statutory filings and business licenses. It also covers records for registered agents and agents for service of process, and the local compliance requirements that differ by country. Government agencies and registries. Deal directly with company registries, tax authorities, chambers of commerce and other government bodies on filings, registrations, certificates and inquiries, some of which need regular follow-up. Compliance calendar. Own the global entity compliance calendar. Know what is due, where and when, and flag it early rather than relying on a service provider's reminder. Directors, officers and authority. Track director and officer appointments and resignations, maintain signature and delegation of authority records, and prepare powers of attorney, incumbency certificates and secretary's certificates. Keep internal systems current and make sure the people who need to know about a change in signing authority are told. Portfolio rationalization. Review the legacy and dormant entities we hold, including those that came in through acquisitions. Form a view on which should be maintained, consolidated or wound down, then carry out the plan. Corporate records and governance Corporate records. Maintain minute books, statutory registers, organizational charts and entity records worldwide, in physical and electronic form, so the portfolio stays audit-ready. Governance documents. Draft board and stockholder resolutions, written consents, minutes for subsidiary matters, and organizational documents such as articles, bylaws and operating agreements, in support of routine governance matters and corporate transactions, for attorney review. Document requests. Turn around internal and external requests for certificates of good standing, certified copies, apostilles and legalizations. These usually block something, so speed matters. KYC and due diligence support Incoming requests. Respond to and manage Know Your Customer (KYC), Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) and related diligence requests from banks, financial partners, customers and other stakeholders. Supporting documentation. Compile and maintain the entity ownership, formation and governance documentation those requests rely on. Working with Finance, Tax and People Entity decisions are rarely made by Legal alone, so a large share of this role is coordination. Tax. Support tax-driven entity changes, restructurings and intercompany arrangements, and provide the corporate approvals, resolutions and records they require. Finance and Treasury. Support statutory audits, bank account openings and closures, and signatory changes. Supply the entity data behind financial reporting and audit requests. People. Work with the People team when we open in a new country. That covers employer registrations, local entity setup and the corporate steps that have to happen before anyone can be hired or paid. Across the company. Be the reliable answer when Procurement, Sales, Real Estate or anyone else needs to know which entity to use, or how Datadog is structured. Systems, data and process Diligent Entities. Own Diligent Entities as our system of record, covering data integrity, configuration and reporting. You will be the internal expert who trains others on it. Data quality. Run periodic audits of entity records, fix records where the data has drifted, and get the register to a point where it can be trusted without a manual check. Process. Build and maintain the trackers, workflows and standard operating procedures the function runs on, and document them well enough that someone else can pick them up. Automation and AI. Work with the wider Legal Operations team to automate the repetitive parts of entity work, and help assess where AI tools earn their place, both here and elsewhere in the department. Entity management is full of high-volume, rules-based work, which makes it a good place to test them. No prior AI experience is needed. Curiosity and judgment about where AI does and does not belong matter more. Securities support Supporting work, learnable on the job, performed for and supervised by our Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Securities. Section 16. Prepare, file and track Forms 3, 4 and 5 for our Section 16 officers and directors, and maintain the supporting ownership records. Forms 144 and 10b5-1. Prepare and file Forms 144 and administer the mechanics of Rule 10b5-1 plan adoptions, modifications and terminations. Entity data for reporting. Supply the entity information behind our periodic SEC filings, including the subsidiary list filed with the Form 10-K. Board support. Support board and committee matters as needed. Board and committee administration sits with our Corporate & Securities group. Your team and the wider function Your direct report. Manage, develop and set priorities for one Corporate Paralegal, and bring them along on the entity work as you standardize it. Shared services. Legal Operations runs as a shared services team. You will be cross-trained across other Legal Operations workstreams, and colleagues will be cross-trained into entity work, so the team can cover for each other and hold consistent standards. Who you are What we need Seven or more years of hands-on entity management experience, with substantial time on a multi-jurisdictional portfolio, whether in-house at a multinational, at a law firm or at a corporate services provider. Practical experience with entity formation and ongoing maintenance in multiple countries, including foreign qualification, good standing, annual filings, registered agents and local statutory requirements. Direct experience dealing with government agencies, company registries and regulators on corporate filings. You have chased a registry, fixed a rejected filing, and learned how long these things take. A track record of working with internal partners outside Legal, such as Finance, Tax and People, where the work only lands if the coordination is good. Proficiency with an entity management platform. We use Diligent Entities. If you have used a comparable system and will become an expert in ours, that works too. Strong document and spreadsheet skills. Legal and Finance work in Word and Excel, and Excel in particular carries a lot of the tracking and reporting in this role. The rest of the company runs on Google Workspace, so you will use both. Drafting skills for corporate governance documents such as resolutions, consents, certificates and minutes. Comfort with the local mechanics of an international portfolio, such as nominee and minority shareholder arrangements, local director requirements and statutory filings that vary by jurisdiction. Organization and attention to detail, and the capacity to hold a high volume of deadlines at once. Judgment about what you handle, what you flag and what you escalate, and the confidence to escalate early. Experience managing or mentoring a junior colleague. Willingness to learn the securities reporting side of the role and to hold those deadlines once trained. Willingness to be cross-trained more broadly across Legal Operations. Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with outside counsel, registered agents and service providers in many countries and time zones. A bachelor's degree, an associate degree or a paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program. If you have none of these, we will consider equivalent relevant experience. Nice to have Exposure to Section 16, Forms 144, Rule 10b5-1 administration or public company reporting. Implementing or migrating an entity management system, or materially improving the data quality of an existing one. Rationalizing a legacy entity portfolio by consolidating or winding down dormant companies, including entities acquired through M&A. Evaluating, piloting or rolling out legal technology or AI tools. Supporting restricted party or sanctions screening. Work at a multinational technology or SaaS company, or supporting one from a firm or service provider. A notary public commission in New York, or willingness to obtain one. Certification from NALA, the National Association of Legal Assistants (Certified Paralegal or Advanced Certified Paralegal), or from NFPA, the National Federation of Paralegal Associations (CORE Registered Paralegal or PACE Registered Paralegal). If you are strong on the entity management core and lighter on some of the rest of the two lists above, we would still like to hear from you. We are hiring for depth in the part of this role that is hardest to teach. #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. title: Mid Market Account Executive
description: アカウントエグゼクティブ（Mid-Market担当） DatadogのMid-Market Salesチームでは、従業員数1,000～5,000名規模の企業をターゲットに、新規顧客の獲得を通じて事業成長を支えるアカウントエグゼクティブ（AE）を募集しています。 本ポジションでは、中堅〜大手企業に対する新規営業活動を戦略的にリードし、契約獲得まで一貫して担当いただきます。 当社の営業メンバーは、明確に定義されたセールスメソッドに基づき、社内ステークホルダーやパートナーエコシステムと連携しながら、顧客ごとの課題やニーズを深く理解し、Datadogのソリューション価値を的確に伝えています。Mid-Market AEとして、営業スキルをさらに磨きながら、Datadogのチームの成功に継続的に貢献できるキャリアパスが用意されています。 Datadogでは、オフィス文化を非常に大切にしています。対面での関係構築やコラボレーションが生む創造性を重視しながらも、ハイブリッドワーク環境を採用することで、一人ひとりに合った柔軟なワークライフバランスの実現を支援しています。 【業務内容】 新規ロゴ（新規顧客）獲得に特化した営業活動 交渉から技術デモに至るまで、営業サイクル全体をリード 商談の背景にあるビジネス要因を正確に把握 顧客の業務や事業構造を深く理解し、適切なアプローチを設計 CTO、エンジニアリング／ITリーダー、SRE・DevOps・DevSecOpsなどの技術系ステークホルダーへの戦略的アプローチ 複雑な組織内の複数部門にまたがるマルチスレッド営業 SDR（Sales Development Representative）、パートナー、マーケティングと連携したリード創出活動 Sales NavigatorやDemandbaseなどのツールを活用した、リアルタイム信号・リサーチに基づくモダンな営業戦略の実践 【求める人物像】 新たなテクノロジーに対する好奇心が強く、それらがビジネス成果とどう関わるかに興味がある方 新規顧客開拓（ハンティング）に実績があり、アカウントマッピングや潜在顧客へのアプローチに長けている方 パイプライン創出スキルが高く、顧客の前でも物怖じせず、自発的かつ創造的に行動できる方 出張を含む営業活動に対応可能な方（移動手段：車・電車・飛行機／最大30%） 【待遇・成長機会】 成果に応じた高い収入を実現可能 成績上位者に贈られる「President’s Club」への選出チャンス 入社時に付与されるストックオプション（RSU）および従業員持株購入制度（ESPP） 継続的なプロダクト研修、営業・技術両面のトレーニング、明確なキャリアパス 社内メンター・バディ制度によるネットワーキング支援 多様性を尊重したインクルーシブな企業文化と、社内コミュニティ（Guilds）への参加機会 グローバルで充実した福利厚生制度 ※上記の福利厚生・報酬制度は、勤務国および雇用形態により異なる場合があります。 Datadogでは、多様なバックグラウンドを持つ方々を歓迎しています。すべての要件を初日から満たしている必要はありません。 テクノロジーへの情熱があり、経験を積みたいという意欲がある方は、ぜひご応募ください。あなたの成長を全力でサポートします。 #LI-Hybrid About Datadog: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Principal Copywriter, Brand Editorial
description: Datadog's brand is entering a new chapter, and we're looking for a Principal Copywriter, Brand Editorial to own and evolve how we sound. As the founding writer on a multidisciplinary team of designers, illustrators, motion artists, and producers, you'll shape the ideas and narratives that define how Datadog shows up in the world. You'll also build the systems, standards, and tools that help thousands of colleagues scale brand voice and the company. You'll go deep on how the products actually work, then turn that complexity into clear, powerful ideas. You'll pair exceptional craft with real conceptual ambition, and raise the bar on both. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You'll Do: Define and evolve Datadog's writing style, tone, and point of view, setting a consistent quality bar across campaigns, events, web, video, social, product marketing, and other brand experiences. Concept and write high-impact brand work, including campaigns, videos, launches, and major event experiences, as well as ongoing work across social, web, and sales enablement. Build practical voice and messaging systems, including style guidance, messaging frameworks, and writing standards that teams can apply confidently in their day-to-day work. Encode Datadog's voice into AI-enabled writing workflows by designing prompts, custom skills, evaluation approaches, and guardrails that help teams create and improve on-brand drafts. Partner early with Brand, Creative, Product Marketing, Web, Corporate Communications, and other teams to establish messaging before execution and strengthen briefs, concepts, critiques, and production. Scale writing quality beyond your own output by coaching internal partners and enabling agencies and contractors to apply Datadog's voice consistently without creating a bottleneck. Who You Are: You have 8+ years of writing experience and a portfolio demonstrating range across brand campaigns, voice or messaging systems, long-form storytelling, and concise creative copy. You have written for developer, technical, or enterprise audiences and can communicate complex technology clearly without losing the substance that matters to practitioners. You have built or substantially shaped voice guidelines, messaging frameworks, or writing standards that other people have successfully used. You are a hands-on creative leader who can establish direction, exercise strong editorial judgment, influence partners, and carry work through production. You build with AI, not just around it. You're technology curious, you stay on top of modern workflows, and you have experience turning your writing standards into tools an entire organization can scale with. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, collaborating across functions, sharing your craft generously, and helping an evolving brand and its teams become stronger communicators. Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. Benefits & Growth: Generous and competitive benefits package New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan Continuous career development and pathing opportunities Employee-focused best in class onboarding Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program Friendly and inclusive workplace culture Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $153,000 — $204,000 USD About Datadog: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. title: Product Manager ll - Code Intelligence
description: As a Product Manager - Code Intelligence , you will define, build, and launch capabilities that proactively detect infrastructure issues in code (e.g. Terraform, Helm) and recommend changes before they can be deployed into production and escalate into production incidents. The Infrastructure Monitoring team has pioneered shift-left detection in the industry with Bits Infrastructure Operations , and we’re looking for a Product Manager to expand this capability to a broader set of use cases. Customers (and thus developers) are increasingly standardizing on IaC tools to deploy and maintain ever-growing infrastructure in the cloud. At the same time, SREs and Infra teams struggle with an increasing number of production incidents. By shifting-left and building agentic capabilities in the dev workflow, we can identify high-impact infra changes before they are deployed, help reduce production incidents, reduce waste, and free up SRE time to focus on value-added tasks. You will own the roadmap to expand these agentic capabilities to a broader set of use cases, including cost detection, blast radius impact, as well as configuration changes on infrastructure powering applications like nginx, postgres and more. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, and customers to build and iterate on the roadmap, build product market fit, drive customer adoption (including internal usage), and focus on coverage and correctness of the AI system. This is an opportunity to lead an initiative at the intersection of AI, infrastructure operations, and autonomous observability. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. description: Datadog’s Recruiting Operations team is on a mission to scale and optimize the Recruiting organization through operational efficiency, best-in-class tooling, analytics, and programs. You will be the person who tells the difference, decides what Datadog adopts, designs the workflows that put it to work, and makes sure we use it in a way that is fair to candidates and defensible to regulators. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: As a Senior Security Engineer within Application Security at Datadog, you will help secure emerging application architectures where established security patterns may not yet exist, including agentic applications, LLM-enabled products, protocol-driven tool use, and untrusted execution environments. You will establish and validate security models, requirements, and controls while partnering with product and platform teams to develop secure-by-default approaches. Your work will address evolving trust boundaries, agent identity, data access, tool permissions, and runtime behavior through threat modeling, security solutions, and practical implementation. You will have the opportunity to shape how Datadog safely supports new application paradigms and address emerging security risks before they become systemic. Design, implement, and validate practical security controls that reduce risk in emerging architectures and high-risk system behaviors. Shape how emerging systems authenticate, authorize actions, isolate workloads, and access data, applying least-privilege principles throughout. Partner with product, platform, Infrastructure Security, and other engineering teams to identify security gaps and embed secure-by-default requirements from early design through production. Lead threat modeling and security assessments for new and existing products, focusing on evolving threats, unfamiliar trust boundaries, and new interaction patterns. You have experience in security and/or infrastructure/platform engineering, with exposure to distributed systems, application platforms, or agent-based architectures. You have designed or implemented security controls within application infrastructure, such as authentication, authorization, API security, zero-trust networking, workload protection, sandboxing, or runtime hardening. You understand common application security vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques, including those relevant to LLM applications and agentic systems; familiarity with LLM frameworks and protocols such as MCP or A2A is a plus. You bring strong problem-solving skills and can work independently and collaboratively in ambiguous or rapidly evolving problem spaces.
